plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Minimal themed Claude Code statusline — identity, branch, cwd, model, context bar, world clocks, rotating quote. Pure inline; no MCP server.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Diagram-rendering canvas — Claude draws via D2 / raw SVG / image URLs; operator riffs on a tldraw surface.

plugins.name: nf-backlog-system
plugins.description: A markdown-native backlog for the solo operator — typed items, arcs, and initiatives in plain files you own. Skills to inspect, manage, and update a consumer-owned schema enforced by a validation hook.

plugins.name: nf-workstation-notification-system
plugins.description: Character-voice sound notifications for Claude Code sessions. Voice packs are CDN-hosted and cached locally — swap the whole voice or assign a different voice per notification category. No audio ships in the plugin. macOS only.
